title: Pollinations joins the Vercel AI SDK toolkit
summary:
A garden-maintenance day: smoother SDK access, fresher app stats, and the economics dashboard moved into production.

A Pollinations provider was added to Dev_Tools for the Vercel AI SDK, giving JavaScript builders a more direct path from SDK calls to Pollinations models.

A weekly workflow now updates app star counts, keeping the ecosystem's public map a little less stale. Stars: still an imperfect metric, now at least refreshed regularly.

The Economics Dashboard was deployed to production and cleaned up, making the Pollen-side machinery easier to inspect without wandering through unfinished plumbing.
